title: Aniimo Evolution Levels Explained | Pranky, Pawney, Rookey, Fragrancier and Erlath Guide
description: Five Aniimo evolution routes explained: Skippy to Pranky, Pranky to Glacy or Leafy, Helmut to Pawney or Rookey, Dewy to Fragrancier and Fahloo to Erlath. Levels, requirements, base stats and weaknesses, checked against aniimo.gg and the Dexerto Aniimo wiki in November 2026.
joke: Aniimo evolution is simple: you pick a level, and your Aniimo picks the mood swing.

sections.heading: Intro
sections.script: Evolution is one of the biggest power spikes in Aniimo, but every Aniimo line has its own level and its own requirements, and it is easy to waste time. In this video we go through five evolution routes that people often ask about: Skippy to Pranky and then Glacy or Leafy, Helmut to Pawney or Rookey, Dewy to Fragrancier, and Fahloo to Erlath. For each one you will hear the level you need, what extra task is required, the base stats of the result, and its element weaknesses. The numbers come from aniimo.gg and the Dexerto Aniimo wiki, checked in November 2026. Where a detail only appears on one site, we leave it out. Stay until the end for a short checklist you can use before you evolve anything.

sections.heading: Skippy to Pranky
sections.script: The first route is the Skippy line, and it is the earliest one in this video. Skippy evolves into Pranky at level twelve, with no extra task in the lists we checked. That makes Pranky an easy early upgrade. Pranky is a stage two Water Aniimo with one hundred and nine HP, eighty five attack, sixty six physical defense, ninety eight magic defense, fifty break and seventy four regen. The Aniilog says they like to stay cool and moist, and that is what the film over their bodies is for. As a Water Aniimo it takes one point six times damage from Lightning, Grass and Ice, and it resists Dark and Earth. That magic defense of ninety eight is the highlight, so Pranky handles magic attackers better than it handles physical ones. And Pranky is not the end of the line, because at level twenty it can evolve again, in two different directions.

sections.heading: Glacy or Leafy
sections.script: At level twenty, Pranky splits into Glacy or Leafy, and both are stage three Aniimo with the same basic numbers: one hundred and twenty HP, ninety five attack and fifty break. Glacy is Ice and Water, with seventy two physical defense, one hundred and ten magic defense and eighty eight regen. It is weak only to Grass, and it resists Dark, which makes it the safer pick. Leafy is Grass and Water, with eighty two physical defense, eighty two magic defense and one hundred and six regen. It resists Earth strongly, but Lightning, Ice and Wind all hit it for one point six times damage. The route to Leafy also has a special requirement: you must defeat Alpha Leafy, and the Aniimo must be on the giant lotus leaf where Alpha Leafy resides. Glacy has no such condition in the lists we checked. So Glacy is simpler, and Leafy is the more demanding, healing focused choice.

sections.heading: Helmut to Pawney
sections.script: The second route starts with Helmut, a small Dark Aniimo with sixty HP, fifty two attack, sixty eight physical defense, forty eight magic defense and sixty break. Helmut evolves at level forty five, and there are two outcomes. The first is Pawney. Both sites say you need level forty five, and the Dexerto wiki adds that you must pull out the Sword of Bravery. Pawney is a stage three Dark Aniimo with ninety HP, a very high one hundred and twenty five attack, eighty four physical defense, seventy magic defense, fifty five break and eighty one regen. The Aniilog says that armed with a broken sword and armor, it defends its friends and challenges its foes. Dark Aniimo take one point six times damage from Light and Wind, and they resist Earth, so keep that in mind when you build a team around Pawney. Treat it as a hard hitting damage dealer.

sections.heading: Helmut to Rookey
sections.script: The other outcome of Helmut is Rookey, and it asks for a different kind of effort. Rookey also needs level forty five, but you must defeat the opponent by dealing damage with Counter in Ballistic Guard, and your Aniimo must learn the passive talent Unwavering Rampart. Both aniimo dot gg and Dexerto list those requirements. In return you get a stage three Dark tank with one hundred HP, ninety attack, one hundred physical defense, seventy magic defense, one hundred and five break and seventy five regen. The Aniilog describes it as an unyielding shield. Its weaknesses are the same as Pawney: Light and Wind deal one point six times damage, while Earth is resisted. So the choice is clear. Pawney trades defense for a one hundred and twenty five attack, and Rookey trades attack for a hundred defense and a hundred and five break. Pick the one that matches the role your team is missing.

sections.heading: Dewy to Fragrancier
sections.script: The third route is the simplest of the evolutions with a clear payoff. Dewy evolves directly into Fragrancier at level twenty seven. Both sources agree on the level, and aniimo dot gg lists a single step with no Alpha fight. Fragrancier is a stage three Dark Aniimo with eighty four HP, one hundred and eleven attack, sixty eight physical defense, sixty five magic defense, eighty one break and a very high one hundred and ten regen, for a total of five hundred and nineteen. The Aniilog says they are picky about odors, so they harvest and store nectar to craft unique perfume ingredients. Like the other Dark Aniimo in this video, it takes one point six times damage from Light and Wind and resists Earth. Compared with Pawney, it hits a little softer, but its regen makes it much better at staying in a long fight.

sections.heading: Fahloo to Erlath
sections.script: The last route is Fahloo into Erlath. Fahloo is a Water Aniimo at evolution stage one, and it needs level forty nine to evolve into Erlath. Both sources agree on that number, which is a late level, so plan for it. Fahloo itself has one hundred and two HP, seventy six attack, sixty eight physical defense, seventy six magic defense, forty four break and ninety three regen. The Aniilog says it rubs oils on its body to create lots of foam that cleans and protects it, though it sometimes steps on it and slips. As a Water Aniimo, it takes one point six times damage from Lightning, Grass and Ice, and it resists Dark and Earth. The Dexerto wiki also lists it as easy to catch, so it is a friendly Aniimo to raise if you want a regen focused Water member on your team.

sections.heading: Checklist
sections.script: Here is the short checklist from this video. Skippy evolves at level twelve. Pranky evolves at level twenty into Glacy, or into Leafy if you also defeat Alpha Leafy on the giant lotus leaf. Helmut evolves at level forty five, into Pawney with the Sword of Bravery, or into Rookey with a Counter win in Ballistic Guard and the Unwavering Rampart talent. Dewy evolves into Fragrancier at level twenty seven. Fahloo evolves into Erlath at level forty nine. Before you evolve, remember that elements matter as much as stats: Water Aniimo fear Lightning, Grass and Ice, while Dark Aniimo fear Light and Wind. If a requirement mentions an Alpha, check the fight first, so you are not trying to evolve and fight at the same time.

sections.heading: Your turn
sections.script: Let us end with a joke. In Aniimo, the evolution takes only a moment, but deciding between two evolutions takes an entire evening and several snacks. Now it is your turn. Which of these evolution routes are you going for first, and which Aniimo line should we explain in the next video? Tell us in the comments. If this guide helped you, subscribe to HarryBeast Gaming for more Aniimo guides, and we will see you in the next video.
